comment: Maps each searchable item to its photo and a fixed grid cell [col,row]. Grid is 7x7 for the default 3x3 m area at 0.5 m step (cols/rows 0-6). Items are placed in rows 3-6 so every search runs well into the sweep before the find. The item photo is served only when the drone is on its cell AND the active query matches one of the item aliases; all other cells show a plain room photo.
